article.name: Gini Agent
article.summary: Gini Agent's Hindsight memory subsystem stores structured units in per-instance SQLite and retrieves them through semantic, lexical, graph, and temporal channels. This is a source review, not a measured quality result.

who_what.text: The official README presents Gini Agent as a personal agent runtime with a Bun gateway and multiple clients. Its memory guide distinguishes Hindsight from always-injected USER.md and SOUL.md identity surfaces; this review focuses on Hindsight.

architecture.text: The memory guide places Hindsight in a per-instance SQLite database and model cache in the instance/models directories. The state module defines banks and memory units with world, experience, opinion, and observation networks; temporal, semantic, entity, and causal links; agent/bank scope; provenance and embedding fields.

Retain extracts structured facts, normalizes supported temporal expressions, embeds narratives, inserts units, resolves entities, and creates links. Reflection reuses recall to generate responses and can store opinions; reinforcement updates opinion confidence using structured assessments.

behavior.text: **Writes.** Automatic retain runs at the end of chat tasks; CLI and API surfaces are documented. The implementation requires agentId, uses a structured extraction step, and stores source task/session and embedding metadata when supplied. Extraction quality was not assessed.

**Updates and correction.** The inspected retain path inserts extracted units. Reflection can store opinions, and reinforcement can change opinion confidence; the reviewed documentation/source does not establish a general fact replacement or stale-value correction workflow.

**Deletion.** The memory guide says the Memory page permits pruning individual units. The reviewed documentation/source did not establish physical erasure, tombstones, or cleanup of derived copies and backups.

**Retrieval.** Recall combines semantic vector search, SQLite FTS5 BM25, graph spreading activation, and temporal range matching, fuses rankings, reranks top candidates, and applies a default token budget. Semantic search filters vectors by active model; the guide documents re-embedding after provider changes.

**Scope.** Retain and recall require an agentId. Recall filters each channel by active agent, while the guide describes one bank per agent. This is code evidence, not an adversarial isolation measurement.

**Provenance.** The guide documents source task, trace, and embedding metadata; retain emits audit/trace records. Recall reports channel names and subscores for surfaced units. Citation support was not adjudicated.

metrics.evidence: Four retrieval channels are implemented; no query workload was scored.
Opinion confidence reinforcement exists; no fact correction workload was run.
Individual-unit pruning is documented; no deletion probes were run.
Agent IDs are required and filtered in recall; no cross-scope workload was run.
Provenance metadata and recall diagnostics are documented; no claims were adjudicated.
Candidate limits, reranking and automatic retain/recall are documented; no timings were collected.
Token packing and local model cache status are implemented; no resource measurements were collected.

limits.text: This is a pinned documentation and source review, not a runtime, security, or quality assessment. Extraction accuracy, contradiction resolution, full authorization behavior, and the semantics of Memory-page pruning were not tested.
The temporal parser supports a bounded list of absolute and relative expressions and returns null for unrecognized input. Provider/model configuration can affect extraction and semantic recall.
No Gini Agent runtime, tests, or benchmark workload was run. No measured metric values are available from this review.

benchmark.note: No Gini Agent runtime, tests, or benchmark workload was executed for this review. Project metric definitions, fixture, and status files are not Gini Agent measurements.
